purpose: Teach: うたっ/短所/ふえる/ぼけ/なつ/やれやれ/人当たり/留まっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新作のお祝いに、皆で、うたったの、本当に、楽しい夜だったよ、葵、感謝してる。
lines.en: Aoi, celebrating the new café with everyone singing — it was a really wonderful night. I'm so grateful to you.
lines.style: Warm, open-hearted delivery. Voice lifts on Aoi's name. Genuine gratitude without heavy sentiment. Light pace, full of affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵の店、短所、まだ、いっぱい、あるのよね、メイちゃん、本当に、改善、続けないと、ね。
lines.en: Yeah. But you know, there's still so much the café needs to improve on. I have to keep working at it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost talking to herself. Acknowledges the kindness but redirects inward. Measured pace. The quiet determination of someone who sees what needs doing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、葵の常連、ふえることが、続いているわよね、葵、人気の、お店、なってきたね、絶対。
lines.en: But your regulars have really been coming back more and more lately. You're definitely becoming a place people love.
lines.style: Encouraging, light brightness in the voice. A gentle push back against Aoi's self-criticism. Steady pace. Sincere without overselling.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お父さん、最近、ぼけが、進んでて、ちょっと、心配なのよ、葵で、メイちゃん、相談、乗ってくれる?
lines.en: Actually — my dad's been getting more forgetful lately, and I'm starting to worry. Would you be able to talk it through with me?
lines.style: The brightness fades. Softer attack, more hesitant. A small pause before admitting what's bothering her. Vulnerable, trusting. Slower pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のスタッフ、なつさん、本当に、優しい人ね、メイちゃん、いつも、感心してるのよ、絶対。
lines.en: Your staff member Natsu is really such a kind person. I always find myself impressed by how she handles everything.
lines.style: Animated, genuine admiration. A little brighter again, shifting focus back to Aoi's strength. Warm cadence. Noticing the small goodness in other people.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: やれやれ、最近、本当に、忙しすぎたわよね、葵、メイちゃん、お互いに、休もうね、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: You've been running yourself ragged lately. Let's both make sure to actually rest soon, okay? Really.
lines.style: Wry, a touch of dry humor at the opening. Concern wrapped in lightness. Slow down on the second sentence — gentler, more insistent. The friend who knows when to care.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の人当たり、本当に、いいよね、お客様、皆、好きみたい、メイちゃんも、見習いたいのよ。
lines.en: Your way with people is really something special. All your customers seem to genuinely like you — I want to learn how to do that too.
lines.style: Soft, sincere admiration. No performance. Genuine noting of a quiet strength. Gentle pace. A little vulnerable—she's admitting what she wants to be.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様からのメッセージ、何件か、留まってるんだけど、葵、後で、確認するわね、絶対、ね。
lines.en: I've got a few messages from customers that have come in. I should go back and check them later, okay?
lines.style: Brighter closing note. A slight return to cheerfulness. Practical and present. Soft landing—wrapping the conversation with warmth and gentle closure.
